reason: Independent review found that CORS does not protect WebSocket handshakes. The unauthenticated /ws/agents/chat and /ws/demo/run routes accepted connections from arbitrary browser origins; the demo route can trigger a write-evidence run.
impacted_consumers: Agent Runner and Control UI websocket clients
required_invalidations: Add AC10 to validate the browser Origin before accepting every WebSocket endpoint.
Re-review all WebSocket routes and the exact final candidate fingerprint.
decision: Accepted as required local-browser request-origin protection for the unauthenticated host-local API.
